instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope'. Ensure they are configured in tailwind.config.js.
Use ONLY pure HTML/Tailwind for main layouts (divs, sections). Use Shadcn strictly for complex interactive components (Accordion, Form, Calendar, Dialog).
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
DO NOT use placeholder text or dummy image services. Rely strictly on the media_urls provided.
Ensure contrast ratios are met. Text on primary color background must be dark (text-primary) or clearly visible.
Ensure generous spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for cards, and py-24 for main sections.
